bibl.title: A Philological Note on the Hippo in Graeco-Roman Egypt.
bibl.seg: Klaas A. Worp, A Philological Note on the Hippo in Graeco-Roman Egypt.
Antonio Ricciardetto, Nathan Carlig, Gabriel Nocchi Macedo & Magali de Haro Sanchez (edd.), Le médecin et le livre. Hommages à Marie-Hélène Marganne (Lecce, 2021) pp. 725-732.
bibl.note: Presents a survey of the results of various sources of the Greek term ἱπποπόταμος. P. Oxy. IX, 1220 features a slightly aberrant spelling of the word that may raise an interesting lexical problem. - Appendix. Attestations of the Hippo in Greek and Latin Literature.
